name: uart1_send_txbuf
comment: send first n bytes of uart1_txbuf on USART1 (board A)

name: uart2_send_txbuf
comment: send first n bytes of uart2_txbuf on USART2 (board B)

name: gen_wait_ok
comment: poll gen_ok_state==2 up to 200000 iters, then delay 0x855; timeout ignored

name: u64_pow10_floor
comment: largest power of 10 <= v (at most 1e16); decimal formatting helper

name: uart1_frame_handler
comment: main-loop handler of a completed USART1 frame (g/p/n and deferred w)

name: uart2_frame_handler
comment: main-loop handler of a completed USART2 frame

name: gen_ok_state
comment: u8: 1 after ':o', 2 after 'k'; shared by USART1/USART2 RX

name: uart1_arg_idx
comment: u16: next value index into g/p/w arrays (USART1)

name: uart1_frame_id
comment: u16: letter<<8 | 2-digit number of current USART1 frame

name: uart1_rxbuf
comment: u8[68]: USART1 frame buffer (b[1]=letter, b[2..3]=number digits, b[5..]=payload)
